I have farmed this land for many years with my family, and on this small rented plot of beans we work with our hands and hoes as we always have. I keep my own bean seeds from last season because they are familiar and cost nothing, and I do not buy chemicals for beans since they grow well enough with the rains if we weed properly. My wife and children will help with the planting, weeding, and harvest, so we do not need to hire outside workers for a plot this size.
